owner_speed_alignment.decision: EC11 Type-controlled double-click recovery must meet the same visible notify-ready speed limit as BLE rename recovery.

supersedes.reason: Product owner requires the core EC11 recovery path to meet the stricter rename recovery standard.

recovery_led_contract.decision: After an EC11 double-click recovery has manually restored the Windows BLE link but before Type audio-ready arrives, the visible Bluetooth state must immediately be blue, low-brightness, and double-pulsed. The prior repair cue must not continue as a full-brightness or color-ambiguous double flash after the BLE connection succeeds; normal TYPE:READY rendering remains unchanged.
recovery_led_contract.trigger: operator report: after manual recovery the Bluetooth effect was a generic double flash instead of blue low-brightness double flash
recovery_led_contract.acceptance_requirement: A focused physical operator review and serial evidence must confirm the blue low-brightness double pulse after manual recovery reaches BLE connected and before TYPE:READY; no release claim may substitute simulated color or brightness evidence.
recovery_led_contract.root_cause_regression_gate: python .\tools\verify_status_led_static.py; the repair cue must survive only reset-disconnected/pairing/reconnecting states and yield immediately on BLE_CONNECTED or BLE_TYPE_READY.

ec11_type_repair_recovery.validation_command: cargo test --manifest-path .\src-tauri\Cargo.toml type_observed_recovery_address_skips_duplicate_pairing_advertisement_scan --lib; cargo test --manifest-path .\src-tauri\Cargo.toml embedded_ble_type_observed_recovery_uses_after_cache_type_pairing_path --lib; cargo test --manifest-path .\src-tauri\Cargo.toml type_recovery_promotes_only_trusted_cached_addresses --lib; cargo test --manifest-path .\src-tauri\Cargo.toml embedded_ble_notify_advertisement_evidence_skips_only_the_duplicate_scan --lib; cargo test --manifest-path .\src-tauri\Cargo.toml ble_name_refresh_and_one_click_use_type_controlled_pairasync_recovery --lib; pwsh -NoProfile -File .\scripts\check-ec11-type-recovery-randomized.ps1 -Port COM3 -Iterations 5 -MaxTriggerToTypeReadyMs 10000 -OutputJson <artifact>.json. The installed C:\Program Files\Listener Type\listener-type.exe must be running; every randomized generated EC11 double-click sample must reach firmware TYPE:READY <=10000 ms, reach background listener notify ready <=10000 ms from the Type pre-reset notice, and prove both firmware pre-reset notice send and Type pre-reset notice receipt. This is not a physical GPIO edge measurement. Preserve Type-observed direct PairAsync, no duplicate advertisement scan, no paired link check, GATT reachability, notify enable, Type heartbeat ready, and single-click start/stop without double-click.

ota_transfer_speed.root_cause: The previous metric ended after the OTA GATT version probe and then only requested background-listener refresh, so it did not include the causal TYPE:READY recovery that makes Listener usable again. Low-power active-link handling remains relevant to transfer speed, but it cannot certify user-visible completion by itself.
